title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA-AFRICA FOUNDATION ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA-AFRICA FOUNDATION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea-Africa Foundation Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Approval for Establishment of Branches)
Where the Korea-Africa Foundation under Article 3 of the Korea-Africa Foundation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) (hereinafter referred to as the “Foundation”) seeks approval to establish a branch pursuant to Article 5 (2) of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs an application for approval containing the following matters:
1. The name of the branch;
2. The location of the branch;
3. The reason for its establishment;
4. The scheduled date of establishment;
5. The organizational structure and authorized staffing of the branch;
6. The details of the branch’s duties.

Article 3 (Ex Officio Directors)
“Ex officio directors prescribed by Presidential Decree” in the former part of Article 8 (4) of the Act means a public official designated by the Minister of Planning and Budget from among public officials of the Ministry of Planning and Budget belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and a public official designated by the Minister of Foreign Affairs from among foreign service officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs belonging to the Senior Civil Service. <Amended on Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 4 (Secondment of Public Officials)
(1) When requesting the secondment of public officials pursuant to Article 14 (1) of the Act, the Foundation shall specify the field of expertise, qualification requirements, prospective position, duties to be assigned, etc. of the public officials to be seconded, and shall make the request to the relevant State agency through the Minister of Foreign Affairs.
(2) The Foundation may pay allowances to seconded public officials in connection with their duties as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.

Article 5 (Secondment of Employees)
Where necessary to achieve its objectives and enhance its expertise, the Foundation may, with approval from the Minister of Foreign Affairs, second its employees to State agencies, local governments, research institutions, international organizations, public institutions under the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, etc.

Article 6 (Government Contributions)
(1) By April 30 each year, the Foundation shall submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs a budget request for contributions for the following year, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on Jan. 5, 2021>
1. A business plan and a funds receipts and disbursements plan for the following year;
2. A projected statement of financial position and income statement for the following year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the budget request for contributions.
(2) Where intending to make contributions to the Foundation pursuant to Article 16 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall review the Foundation’s budget request for contributions under paragraph (1) and reflect it in the budget.

Article 7 (Disbursement of Government Contributions)
(1) To receive a contribution under Article 16 (1) of the Act, the Foundation shall submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs an application for disbursement of the contribution, accompanied by a quarterly business plan and budget execution plan, no later than 15 days before the beginning of the relevant quarter.
(2) Upon receiving an application under paragraph (1), the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall disburse the contribution in accordance with the quarterly business plan and budget execution plan where those plans are deemed appropriate.
(3) The Foundation shall report its quarterly business performance and budget execution results to the Minister of Foreign Affairs by the 15th day of the month following the end of each quarter.

Article 8 (Approval of Business Plans and Draft Budgets)
Where seeking approval of its business plan and draft budget pursuant to Article 18 of the Act, the Foundation shall submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs its business plan and draft budget for the following year, accompanied by the following documents, by December 31 each year: <Amended on Jan. 5, 2021>
1. A projected statement of financial position and its supplementary schedules;
2. A projected income statement and its supplementary schedules.

Article 9 (Reporting on Settlement of Accounts)
When submitting its statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure for each business year to the Minister of Foreign Affairs pursuant to Article 19 of the Act, the Foundation shall attach the following documents: <Amended on Jan. 5, 2021>
1. A comparative statement of the business plan for the relevant year and the results of its execution;
2. A statement of financial position and income statement for the relevant year;
3. An opinion of a certified public accountant designated by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and an opinion of the Foundation’s auditor;
4. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 10 (Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 26 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 28465, Dec. 12, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Special Cases Concerning Disbursement of Government Contributions)
Notwithstanding Article 7 (1), where the Minister of Foreign Affairs has approved the business plan and draft budget pursuant to Article 4 of the Addenda to Act No. 14960, the Korea-Africa Foundation Act, the Foundation shall, without delay, submit to the Minister of Foreign Affairs an application for disbursement of a contribution, accompanied by a quarterly business plan and budget execution plan.

ADDENDA (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 473 Statutes to Revise Difficult Statutory Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 31380, Jan. 5, 2021>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35948, Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026; provided, among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 4 of these Addenda, the parts amending Presidential Decrees that were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (27) Omitted.
(28) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea-Africa Foundation Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 3, “of the Ministry of Economy and Finance” is replaced by “of the Ministry of Planning and Budget,” and “Minister of Economy and Finance” by “Minister of Planning and Budget.”
(29) through (176) Omitted.
